units.source_text: 众侍女吟成诗篇甚多，恕不尽载。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting composed many poems; please forgive me for not recording them all.

units.source_text: 夕雾今晚就在这里奉陪父亲宿夜。

en.t: Yugiri stayed here tonight to keep his father company through the night.

units.source_text: 他看见父亲独宿甚是寂寞，深感同情，此后便常常前来奉陪。

en.t: Seeing how lonely his father was sleeping alone, he felt deep sympathy, and from then on he often came to keep him company.

units.source_text: 回想紫夫人在世之时，这一带地方是他所不得走近的，现在却由他任意出入。

en.t: Thinking back to when Lady Murasaki was alive, this was an area he had not been allowed to approach; now he could come and go there as he pleased.
Comparing the present with the past, he was filled with many emotions.
